description: This source file defines the SettingsRootView SwiftUI view, which manages the settings interface for the application. It includes tabbed navigation for various settings sections, permission monitoring, and handling notifications to change the active tab.

methods.name: validTab(for:)
methods.description: Determines the valid tab to display based on permissions and feature flags.

methods.name: refreshSnapshotPaths
methods.description: Async function to update snapshot paths from GatewayConnection.

methods.name: refreshPerms
methods.description: Async function to refresh permission status.

methods.name: updatePermissionMonitoring(for:)
methods.description: Enables or disables permission monitoring based on the selected tab.
